title: Lift the card
summary: Rounded corners and a two-layer shadow make a flat box float.
brief: Give it two shadows: a tight one (0 1px 3px, black at 12% opacity) and a soft one (0 8px 24px, black at 12% opacity).
hints: box-shadow takes a comma-separated list; each shadow is x, y, blur and colour.

children.text: Water the plants before the weekend.

solutionNotes: Two shadows look more natural than one: the tight one anchors the card to the surface and the large, soft one gives it depth. Low-alpha black keeps them gentle. Shadows follow border-radius, so the rounded corners are shaded correctly, and neither property changes the card’s size.
